notes.title: Tabbellarius update 2.0.5
notes.content:
[p]
[b]Update Announcement – Tabbellarius[/b][/p][p]As mentioned at the start of the game’s development, multiplayer was always planned to be removed at some point. I had hoped there would be more enthusiasm for the multiplayer features, but unfortunately, the need for login credentials turned many players away.[/p][p]With this update, all multiplayer elements have been removed, and you no longer need to log in to play. The game now launches seamlessly: when you start [i]Tabbellarius[/i], the engine will automatically check for a save file and load it so you can jump straight back into the story.[/p][p]The main storyline will no longer receive direct content updates, but new adventures will arrive through DLC packs, which mainly feature extra side quests. This approach allows me to release new content more quickly and efficiently.[/p][p]I hope this change encourages more players to give [i]Tabbellarius[/i] another chance.[/p][p]Good luck on your adventures in Niiburia![/p]

notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Emerging from the chaos of November, I bring tidings of new adventures! Brace yourselves for an array of fresh side quests that I've woven into the game's tapestry with the 2.0.0 update. Oh, and by the way, I've reshaped the world map, sparing you the detour through the Batcave to reach mountain town.

I hope everyone has a great year and well have fun with Tabbellarius!

Cheers,

notes.title: Tabbellarius update 1.9.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934675/053b90df3f096773584087a548e98c4e64abee3a.png[/img]



Greetings, brave adventurers of Tabballarius!

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of the highly anticipated Version 1.9.5 update for your favorite fantasy realm! Prepare to embark on a journey like never before, as we introduce a plethora of new features, enhancements, and fixes to elevate your gaming experience to new heights.

🔍 Uncover More Secrets:
Delve deeper into the mysteries of Niiburia as we unveil a trove of new hidden secrets waiting to be discovered. Explore forgotten ruins, decipher cryptic puzzles, and unravel ancient prophecies as you uncover the realm's best-kept secrets.

🗺️ 13 New Side Quests:
The adventure continues with an array of 13 captivating side quests, each offering unique challenges, intriguing narratives, and valuable rewards. From assisting quirky NPCs to solving intricate puzzles, these quests will keep you engaged and entertained for hours on end.

🛠️ Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements:
Your journey through Niiburia will now be smoother than ever! Our dedicated team of developers has tirelessly worked to squash pesky bugs and address performance issues, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable gameplay experience.

To join the adventure and experience all these incredible updates, simply download the latest version (1.9.5) of Tabballarius on your preferred platform. Immerse yourself in a world of fantasy, intrigue, and discovery like never before.

Thank you for your continued support and dedication. We can't wait to see you in the game, uncovering secrets, conquering quests, and fight evil!

Adventure awaits!

notes.title: Tabbellarius update 1.9.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41934675/f74d91c2fa26287de72dd9d5878b2fbe8fd5091b.gif[/img]

I am thrilled to announce the latest update to our beloved game! Tabbellarius version 1.9.4 is now live and ready for you to explore.

This update brings new content to the game, including new side-quests, challenging enemies, and random events for you to discover. I have also fixed several bugs that were affecting gameplay, making your experience smoother and more enjoyable than ever before.

I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to the community for their continued support and feedback. Your input has been invaluable in helping me make Tabbellarius the best game it can be.

Looking ahead on the next update, which I plan to release in June 2023. I can't wait to share what will be in store for you, and I hope you will continue to join me on this epic adventure.

Thank you for playing Tabbellarius!

Sincerely,
Martin Bauer
